name: Range-floor accumulation reversion (15m)
rationale: Price at the FLOOR of its 15m channel while ADX confirms no trend is the grid-bot / market-maker accumulation zone: automated liquidity providers buy the bottom of an established range and the price mean-reverts upward toward the mid. The other side is the momentum seller dumping into support that holds. Edge persists because range-bound crypto spends most of its time oscillating, and channel floors are where passive bids cluster. Distinct from band z-score (bounded channel position, not a mean-distance z). Disconfirmer: exits when range_position recovers toward the mid, or the stop fires if the floor breaks (range regime ended).
catalyst: price at channel floor in a non-trending regime
